description: Geluid van windturbines (Lden) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Deze kaart toont de berekende geluidsbelasting voor heel Nederland, op een resolutie van 10 meter. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are basisset-novex, belasting, geluid, model, stamina. It offers 8 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ZIP. The portal shows 2026-08-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
